page.overview:
Who is Mr. Sayer?

Mr. Sayer is the manager at Burger Mart and was Mark Grayson's boss. He complains to Mark that he is 45 minutes late for work and that he has been late 12 times in the past 3 months. Mr. Sayer decides to dock Mark's shifts, only for Mark to quit on the spot.

During the Invincible War, Burger Mart was seen ablaze on Fire, it's unknown if Sayer got out of the building safely {{Appearances Season 1
